credit: Self-contained variant of CBC cannon_carriage/carriage_axle.json. Inline texture refs sidestep Flywheel PartialModel parent-alias resolution issues that caused purple/black missing texture when the parent chain 'createbigcannons:block/cannon_carriage/textures' supplied the #axis / #axis_top aliases (see Flywheel PartialModelEventHandler.onRegisterAdditional which only bakes models present in PartialModel.ALL at bake time and cannot re-resolve parent chains lazily). Textures are our own 16x16 brass_axis.png / brass_axis_top.png (generated by .temp/make_brass_axis.js with a zero-dependency PNG encoder, verified by two independent decoders), painted with Create's brass ramp sampled from the extracted create:block/brass_casing palette (#ffeb8c #f7cb6c #e4b763 #cea05a #9e6947 #724731 #492f1b #3a2415 #301e12) so the axle reads as a brass-cased drive shaft per user request '提取出create中黄铜机壳包覆的传动轴的贴图'. Geometry stays Create's shaft: only columns x=6..9 are opaque, exactly like create:block/axis, so the face UV rects [6,0,10,12] and the end-cap UV [6,6,10,10] work unchanged; the sleeve adds casing collars + rivet dots and the cap a bearing bore. This keeps the earlier request '耳轴使用的黄铜贴图也应该改回机械动力转轴的样式' (Create shaft silhouette) while dropping the grey iron axis and all create: texture references from this partial. Face UV rects and rotation angles copied verbatim from CBC's original carriage_axle.json. The two faces with UV [0,0,0,0] are CBC's design choice to make the axle half-cubes' inner meeting faces invisible so the two halves butt together at model X=8 without z-fighting.
